title: polystichum acrostichoides var. incisum
intro: Polystichum acrostichoides var. incisum, commonly known as the Autumn fern, is a type of evergreen fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Autumn fern include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for stress relief. The bioactive constituents of Autumn fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
